objective: Auditar Ventas Cerradas del 01 al 24 de septiembre de 2026 para 130MID, CIENFUEGOS, ESTELAR, 130QRO y ORIGEN. Comparar fuente POS real contra EDARSAHUB por fecha en ventas_total, tickets_total y pax_total. Solo lectura; no resincronizar ni modificar datos. Etiqueta: Sincronizador.

queries.name: sr_sep01_24_offset0
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CONVERT(date, DATEADD(hour, -0, tr.apertura)) AS fecha_operacion,
    CAST(ROUND(SUM(ISNULL(ch.total,0)),2) AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas_total,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ch.folio) AS tickets_total,
    SUM(ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0)) AS pax_total
FROM cheques AS ch
INNER JOIN turnos AS tr
    ON tr.idturno = ch.idturno
WHERE CONVERT(date, DATEADD(hour, -0, tr.apertura))
      BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-24'
  AND ch.cancelado = 0
GROUP BY CONVERT(date, DATEADD(hour, -0, tr.apertura))
ORDER BY fecha_operacion

queries.name: estelar_sep01_24_offset9
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CONVERT(date, DATEADD(hour, -9, tr.apertura)) AS fecha_operacion,
    CAST(ROUND(SUM(ISNULL(ch.total,0)),2) AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas_total,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ch.folio) AS tickets_total,
    SUM(ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0)) AS pax_total
FROM cheques AS ch
INNER JOIN turnos AS tr
    ON tr.idturno = ch.idturno
WHERE CONVERT(date, DATEADD(hour, -9, tr.apertura))
      BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-24'
  AND ch.cancelado = 0
GROUP BY CONVERT(date, DATEADD(hour, -9, tr.apertura))
ORDER BY fecha_operacion

queries.name: qro_sep01_24
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CAST(ve.Vn_Fecha AS date) AS fecha_operacion,
    CAST(ROUND(SUM(ISNULL(ve.Vn_Precio_Neto_Importe,0)),2) AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas_total,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ve.Vn_Folio) AS tickets_total,
    SUM(ISNULL(c.Co_Personas,1)) AS pax_total
FROM Venta_Encabezado ve
LEFT JOIN Comanda c
  ON ve.Vn_Documento = c.Co_Folio
 AND ve.Sc_Cve_Sucursal = c.Sc_Cve_Sucursal
WHERE ve.Vn_Fecha >= '2026-09-01'
  AND ve.Vn_Fecha < '2026-09-25'
  AND ve.Sc_Cve_Sucursal = '0021'
  AND ISNULL(ve.Es_Cve_Estado,'') IN ('AC','FA')
GROUP BY CAST(ve.Vn_Fecha AS date)
ORDER BY fecha_operacion

 AND ve.Sc_Cve_Sucursal = c.Sc_Cve_Sucursal

  AND ve.Sc_Cve_Sucursal = '0023'
  AND ISNULL(ve.Es_Cve_Estado,'') IN ('AC','FA')

queries.name: hub_sep01_24
queries.sql:
SELECT
    u.codigo,
    k.fecha_operacion,
    CAST(ROUND(SUM(ISNULL(k.ventas_total,0)),2) AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas_total,
    SUM(ISNULL(k.tickets_total,0)) AS tickets_total,
    SUM(ISNULL(k.pax_total,0)) AS pax_total,
    COUNT(*) AS registros_activos
FROM dbo.Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2 k
INNER JOIN dbo.Unidades_Negocio u
  ON CONVERT(varchar(36),u.id)=CONVERT(varchar(36),k.unidad_negocio_id)
WHERE ISNULL(k.activo,1)=1
  AND k.fecha_operacion BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-24'
  AND u.codigo IN ('130MID','CIENFUEGOS','ESTELAR','130QRO','ORIGEN')
GROUP BY u.codigo,k.fecha_operacion
ORDER BY u.codigo,k.fecha_operacion
